Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `lunar` (Cosmic eye), 56 x 28 px at 32 a stud, 13 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Moon. VFX: to the sky (Cosmic, Effects.luau): a moonlight glow over its head pulses
every 6 s (the Light at Top), four moon-dust motes orbit its body (the Orbit at Body), a ground
ring of runes rolls out every 3 s and turns as it goes (the RingPulse at Feet), a held aura of
pale moonlight (the Aura at Body), a low indigo mist breathes off its paws (the Emitter at
Feet) and a violet trail streams from its tail while it moves (the Trail); every 20 s the howl
(the flourish): a column of moonlight straight up from its head and a flare of twenty-four
twinkles (the Pillar and Burst at Top); the floating moon, the tufts' and ears' tips, the flank
runes, the leg marks, the tail's core, the mane's caught stars and the chain's broken ends glow
and step through periwinkle, full-moon white and deep violet (the glow cycle); it breathes 3
percent; in the rig the moon bobs and rocks over its brow, the silver crescent rocks behind its
mane, two lit motes circle its shoulders, the broken chain swings, the ears flick and the
forked tail wags, and the howl is a crouch, a hop into a full turn, a rear back with the ears
up, the moon and the crescent flaring and the motes leaping
